webview2-sdk.license: Microsoft WebView2 SDK licence (LICENSE.txt in the package); to be checked at the first download and copied into THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md
webview2-sdk.use: Downloaded by tools/fetch-webview2.ps1 into third_party/ (never committed). Headers at build time; the loader library WebView2LoaderStatic.lib is linked into the exe. The WebView2 runtime is part of Windows and is not shipped.
webview2-sdk.note: archive_sha256 is pinned by the owner after checking the first download; while it is empty the fetch script prints the hash and stops.
